run_all_evals: run all evaluations including CLM, MLM, and machine translation metrics on valid and test sets
evaluate_clm: evaluate causal language model perplexity and next-word prediction accuracy for a given language pair
evaluate_mlm: evaluate masked language model perplexity and prediction accuracy with random word masking
evaluate_mt: evaluate machine translation perplexity, accuracy, and BLEU score for a source-target language pair
eval_memory_usage: evaluate memory slot usage statistics including KL divergence, Gini coefficient, and top-k coverage
